dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: Considering a lot of what happened was pretty unexpected... Well, unexpected for Sorush, anyhow.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: With the sign extinguished, I assume Sorush has also learned much from the Chaplet.

dialogues.speaker: Mihir
dialogues.text: The greater struggle itself, however, is not over. As Pari, our duty remains even with the quelling of the sign.
